data.content_ref: inline:Introduce a second dimension of 'suspension depth' as a primitive in the fixed-point operator, not as a post-pass: each node carries a counter equal to the minimum, over all attackers, of the maximum suspension depth of that attacker's defeaters; acceptance at depth d means the node is grounded after d rounds of simultaneous reinstatement. The operator is monotone on the product lattice of labels and bounded integers, so the least fixed point is unique and computable in polynomial time; reinstatement emerges as an increase in depth rather than a label change. This strengthens the extension by allowing a hierarchy of groundedness. Criticism: the choice of depth metric is arbitrary and may overfit to one notion of defense strength.
